title: Data Manipulation: INSERT, UPDATE, DELETE
description: Modify rows inside tables using DML commands: INSERT INTO, UPDATE, and DELETE FROM.

blocks.content:
DML commands:

- `INSERT INTO table (cols) VALUES (vals)` — adds new rows.
- `UPDATE table SET col = val WHERE condition` — updates existing rows.
- `DELETE FROM table WHERE condition` — deletes matching rows.

blocks.prompt: Update the salary of employee named "Alice" to 75000 in the `employees` table, then return all rows.
blocks.starterCode: -- Update Alice salary and select all
blocks.schema_sql: CREATE TABLE employees (id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, name TEXT, salary REAL);
blocks.answer_sql: UPDATE employees SET salary = 75000 WHERE name = 'Alice'; SELECT * FROM employees;
